exposure: supine hypotension syndrome (SHS) during C-section under spinal anesthesia
use of a 3D-printed modified uterine displacement device
outcome: fetal outcomes (including resuscitation and adverse events)
finding: The study found a notable prevalence of SHS during C-sections under spinal anesthesia, with a 3D-printed modified uterine displacement device showing promise in reducing SHS incidence and optimizing maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The findings underscore the need for tailored interventions to mitigate SHS risk and optimize maternal and neonatal outcomes during C-sections under spinal anesthesia, with the 3D-printed device showing promise.
